messages:
kevin: secret-scanner flagged a wrapped transit ciphertext and a cleartext PEM bundled inside a CI artifact: gs://ci-artifacts/builds/2026-03-22/45678.tar.gz -> member secrets/install.pem + transit:ciphertext=... :rotating_light:

secret-scanner: pattern matched 'transit:ciphertext=' and 'BEGIN PRIVATE KEY' in same archive (blob id: c0ffee). confidence 0.95

nina: ack. risk: if CI runner SA can impersonate the rotation SA or has unwrap perms, attacker could mint tokens and call unwrap. need containment and RBAC hardening.

ollie: immediate containment plan:
- revoke CI runner SA tokens (short-lived) and suspend pipeline distributed runners
- copy original artifact to gs://sec-evidence/4987654321/ (read-only) and overwrite artifact with redacted stub
- rotate affected GH app key / service keys referenced in PEM
- tighten IAM: remove iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator from CI SA, restrict KMS & Vault unwrap to rotation-SA only

tara: I'm taking evidence copy and scrub now. cmd: `gsutil cp gs://ci-artifacts/... /tmp && gsutil cp /tmp/45678.tar.gz gs://sec-evidence/4987654321/` then `gsutil rm gs://ci-artifacts/... && gsutil cp redacted_stub gs://ci-artifacts/...`

kevin: Vault notes: check if transit/unwrap is allowed to CI principal. run: `vault read auth/gcp/login` and `vault token-lookup` for service bindings. If unwrap possible, revoke those tokens and rotate transit key. Rewrap example:
```
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext="$CIPHERTEXT" -format=json > rewrapped.json
```

ollie: GCP IAM snippet to remove tokenCreator from CI SA and grant to rotation-sa only:
```
# remove broad binding
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member="serviceAccount:ci-runner@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
# add to rotation-sa
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member="serviceAccount:rotation-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
```

nina: also enable/inspect audit logs: BigQuery export of admin activity for KMS and IAM for the last 7 days, and Vault audit logs (if using file/audit sink). Flag any tokens minted by CI SA in last 72h.

tara: partner CI owner notified and paused their pipeline. evidence copied to gs://sec-evidence/4987654321/ (read-only). redacted placeholder uploaded. retention 90d for forensics.

legal-bot: received. include: affected partner, blob id, potential privilege escalation via SA impersonation, mitigation steps taken. legal recommends holding external disclosure until we confirm no token misuse.

kevin: timeline proposal: 0-1h: suspend runners + preserve evidence + RBAC revoke; 1-3h: rotate exposed keys and revoke derived tokens; 3-8h: rewrap/rotate transit keys if unwrap misuse possible; 8-72h: audit logs, postmortem, partner notice as advised by legal.

ollie: temporary Vault policy push: restrict transit/rewrap/unwrap to rotation-sa and acl for rotation service. PR includes 12h auto-rollback label. will link PR here.

nina: add scanner rule to detect PEM inside archive members and transit:ciphertext co-occurrence (low-false positive). also add alert for CI SA creating tokens or impersonation calls.

tara: scrub complete, evidence path + manifest shared with partner SRE. partner confirmed deletion of local copies and will rotate any referenced keys.

kevin: after rotation we'll run a verification step: attempt unwrap with rotation-sa (in dry-run) and confirm CI SA cannot. then re-enable pipelines.

ollie: scheduling short maintenance window for KMS key version bump and transit rewrap. will coordinate with infra and rotation-sa.

kevin: thanks. please post updates here when each milestone is done. :white_check_mark:
